$comment: Template for the OpenID Connect sign-in settings. Copy it to oidc.json, then replace the example host names, the client ID and the placeholder secret with your own values. Remove private_networks when the issuer has a public address. If a private CA signed the provider's certificate, add an item { "category": "oidc", "key": "ca_cert", "value": "<PEM text>" }. Apply the file on standard input, with a dry run first: deploy/bin/memory-admin provision apply - --dry-run < oidc.json, then deploy/bin/memory-admin provision apply - < oidc.json.
